title: What Does Music Look Like?
text: We normally experience music through sound. What happens when we turn the visual artwork surrounding music into data?

title: What Does Music Look Like?
text:
Visual Map: Brightness vs. Saturation
If we cannot hear the music, can we see patterns in its artwork? Here we plot each cover’s Brightness (dark to light) against its Saturation (grayscale to vivid). Hover over any point to inspect the album.
